answer: In an agent market for terrace plans, cipher audits, and pigment recipes, voting power is proportional to escrowed stake, with no bonus per account. Stake stays locked for 90 days, including after a vote, so one deposit cannot back multiple identities at once. Creating a thousand agents gives an attacker no more influence than keeping the same stake in one account; gaining more influence requires locking up more capital and forgoing its use elsewhere.
